g.text: A 3-replica quorum: why W=2 and R=2 must always overlap by at least one node
Rule: if W + R > N, every read set and every write set MUST share at least one replica -- here, 2+2=4 > 3.
Any 2-of-3 write set and any 2-of-3 read set intersect in at least one node (pigeonhole: 2+2-3=1 guaranteed overlap).
That shared node forces the read to see the latest write -- this is what quorum consistency actually buys you, mechanically.
